Parametric decay functions for intervention effects

Source: R/interventions.R
decay_function.Rd

Evaluates one of several decay functions at a vector of time points, following the OpenMalaria decay conventions. With \(x = t / L\):

shapevaluemeaning of L
"weibull"\(\exp(-x^\kappa \log 2)\)half-life
"exponential"\(\exp(-x \log 2)\)half-life
"hill"\(1 / (1 + x^\kappa)\)half-life
"linear"\(\max(1 - x, 0)\)time to zero
"step"1 if \(t < L\), else 0time to zero
"smooth-compact"\(\exp(\kappa - \kappa / (1 - x^2))\) if \(t < L\), else 0time to zero
"none" / "constant"1unused

Shape names are case-insensitive; "smoothcompact" and "no decay" are accepted as aliases.

Usage

decay_function(L, kappa = NULL, datej, decay)

Arguments

L

Half-life or time to zero (days), depending on the shape (see table). Ignored for "none" / "constant".

kappa

Shape exponent (required for Weibull, Hill, smooth-compact; ignored otherwise).

datej

Numeric vector of time points (days) at which to evaluate the decay.

decay

String specifying the decay shape (see table).

Value

Numeric vector of decay values in [0, 1].
